identificationModule.briefTitle: IBI363 as Neoadjuvant Therapy in Resectable Stage II-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of IBI363 as Neoadjuvant Therapy in Resectable Stage II-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase 2 study to evaluate the safety, and efficacy of IBI363 as Neoadjuvant Therapy in Resectable Stage II-III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.

conditions: Resectable Stage II-III Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Neoadjuvant Therapy
armGroups.description: Neoadjuvant therapy period : Subjects will receive IBI363 for up to 4 cycles before surgery

interventions.name: IBI363
interventions.description: Subjects will receive IBI363 for up to 4 cycles, each cycle is 21 days, the first treatment cycle is 28 days

primaryOutcomes.description: pCR rate is defined as no residual invasive viable tumor in both the primary tumor (lung) and the sampled lymph nodes after neoadjuvant therapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 8 weeks following completion of neoadjuvant treatment

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the incidence of Treatment-related Adverse Event, (TRAEs)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the incidence of immune-related adverse events (irAEs)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the incidence of adverse events of special interest (AESIs)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the incidence of serious adverse events (SAE)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the relatedness of infusion-related reactions (IRRs) to the investigational product and their severity
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety parameters: the surgery delay rate
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 8 weeks following completion of neoadjuvant treatment

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of subjects with abnormal and clinically significant results including routine blood tests, blood biochemical tests, coagulation tests,, routine urine tests, pregnancy tests，ECG, etc
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: up to 90 days after the last dose

secondaryOutcomes.description: EFS is defined as the time from the first dose to the first determination by the investigator with RECIST v1.1 of inoperable disease progression, postoperative local recurrence or distant metastasis, development of another primary tumor, or death from any cause, whichever occurred first.
mPR rate is defined as ≤ 10% residual invasive viable tumor in both the primary tumor (lung) and the sampled lymph nodes after neoadjuvant therapy.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 8 weeks following completion of neoadjuvant treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects assessed by the investigators as achieving complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to approximately 8 weeks following completion of neoadjuvant treatment

locations.facility: Cancer Hospital Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences
